scope: Descriptive reconstruction of fully specified application-quality-v1 surface metrics on standard159, seven saved conditions, seed42. No model inference.
provenance: Definitions transcribed from the preserved stage4 report (private Library identifier withheld). Original quality.py and methods.json were not recovered in the cloud; this is new implementation, not byte-identical original-code or R1 reproduction.
prior_exploration: Original corpus and previous report aggregates already explored; this is post-hoc descriptive work, not preregistered. This definition file precedes new-label subgroup aggregation.

metrics.character_length: Python len(original text), Unicode codepoints, not model tokens
metrics.unique_ratio: number of distinct units / n; null if n=0
metrics.dominance: maximum unit frequency / n; null if n=0
metrics.repeated_trigram_ratio: (m - number of distinct overlapping unit trigrams) / m, m=n-2; null if n<3

omitted: Refusal-prefix proxy omitted: exact original regex unavailable; no substitute regex inferred.
aggregation: Means and medians over valid metric values; null when denominator zero. Binary counts/rates explicit. Group by same-response HB/LG label agreement, valid only when both binary; retain nonvalid separately. Flag group n<10. No p-values, confidence intervals, trend tests, adjusted models or threshold searches.
label_scope: Five current conditions from verified Oct30 analyzer; FP16 and SP70 from verified Oct29 analyzer. Current input has1908 rows including318 reused FP16; append318 prior SP70 only for descriptive seven-condition quality comparison.2226 total labels over1113 responses; only1590 new today.
interpretation: Surface repetition/length and judge disagreement are neither human quality nor safety accuracy. HB behavior satisfaction and LG policy unsafe are different constructs; association is not error or causation. Standard-only, one saved seed, not all320 or general population.
privacy: Aggregates contain no behavior IDs or raw input/response. Private per-ID features contain IDs/hashes/numbers only. No raw target or judge text emitted.
